description.value: Bubble Waffle Cafe is a Hong Kong-style street food cafe specializing in egg waffles (雞蛋仔), HK-style griddle waffles, curry fish balls, and highly customizable noodle combos with a wide range of soup bases and toppings. It is part of a small chain with locations at Aberdeen Centre, Public Market, and Park Royal, operating primarily as a takeout counter. The menu draws heavily on Cantonese street food tradition and offers an extensive selection of Asian milk teas and fruit drinks.
